locators.content: destination view and explicit destinations; Table 149
Embedded Go-To action; Table 204 printed p.513 / physical p.528; Table 205 continues printed p.514 / physical p.529

source.errata_notes: The effective §12.3.2.2 NOTE expressly records the 2020 correction extending integer page destinations to embedded Go-To actions. No EC3 change to Table 149's eight view forms was found in this bounded source check. Named-destination same-key string-vs-name precedence is B08 and excluded.

features.requirement: A destination determines page, window location on page, and zoom; when a destination is followed its specified view is presented.
features.status_evidence: Local/open destination geometry is applied in viewer-core Open::apply_view; remote/embedded action path appears to retain only page index (see finding).

features.requirement: First item is indirect page object, except GoToR/GoToE where it is an integer page number in target document; remote numbering starts at zero.
features.reader_behavior: Local page objects resolve against source page tree; remote/embedded integer against target page list.
features.tests: Local model test ensures integer isn't current-document page; GoToR/GoToE tests select target index 2 from [2 /Fit], distinguishing 0-based numbering. No user-facing test explicitly checks invalid negative/out-of-range target index; source requirement on value is producer-side, so this audit does not infer a mandatory rejection policy.

features.requirement: All coordinates are default user-space values; content bounds are clipped to crop box for FitB family.
features.tests: viewer-core/tests/destinations_residual_audit.rs uses non-origin CropBox and independent calculations for FitBH/FitBV and page-fit positive controls.

features.requirement: Place (left,top) at upper-left and magnify by zoom; null retains each current component; zoom 0 is null.
features.tests: pdf-model test distinguishes parsed null from 0 coordinate; current residual viewer test establishes non-default opening view then navigates to equal-sized page, asserting independent retained scale/location and controls.

features.requirement: Fit entire page using smaller of horizontal/vertical magnification and center in other dimension.
Fit full page width / height respectively and place specified top / left at corresponding window edge; null retains that coordinate.
features.tests: FitH has independent scale and scroll assertions in headless.rs; FitV is a control in destinations_residual_audit.rs with non-origin crop and independent expected scale/origin.

features.requirement: Fit the rectangle using the smaller horizontal/vertical scale; center the rectangle within the window in the other dimension. No rectangle corner is required to coincide with a window corner.
features.tests: Existing headless.rs checks the 200x100 rectangle's scale (1.5) in a 300x400 viewport but asserts origin (-150,-150), which pins its upper-left to the window corner and contradicts the centering sentence. For rect [100,600,300,700], correct origin is (-150,-25) (viewport has 250 unused vertical pixels, centered as 125 each). Parent is adding an independently calibrated matched-aspect and unused-dimension regression; not run in this shard.

features.requirement: Fit the entire content bounding box, bounded by crop box; center the bounding box within the window in the other dimension.
features.tests: Existing headless.rs tests the single painted 200x100 rectangle and asserts same corner-only placement as FitR. Since current apply_view uses that same top-left corner branch, the assertion is contrary to Table 149. Parent's matching-aspect and 300x400 centered-box regression will also clarify /FitB; not run in this shard.

features.requirement: Fit bounding-box width/height and treat their top/left operands as default-user-space coordinates.
features.tests: destinations_residual_audit.rs tests FitBH and FitBV with a non-origin crop, manual expected values and distinct FitH/FitV page-box controls.

features.requirement: Local GoTo D resolves as §12.3.2 destination; optional SD should take precedence.
features.tests: pdf-model tests SD precedence; action_triggers_spec_audit checks OpenAction GoTo page selection but not action view. Scratch public test asserts an activated local GoTo /XYZ changes target page, scale and origin; local direct destination geometry is independently covered in headless and destinations_residual_audit.

features.requirement: D identifies target file destination; an explicit destination uses zero-based integer page index; SD identifies remote structure ID and should precede D.
features.tests: remote_go_to.rs checks file request, page 2 of four target pages, and SD target page. It does not assert destination zoom/location.

features.requirement: D identifies target embedded-document destination; explicit integer page uses target and starts at zero; root/child path is resolved within embedded file tree.
features.tests: embedded_go_to.rs proves child target and page index 2 of three pages. It does not assert destination zoom/location.
